description_en: Use this API to query webCall call records
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以查询webCall通话记录信息
name: CloudQueryWebcallCdr

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of a call record. If you specify this parameter, other filter parameters are ignored, and only the call record with this unique ID is returned
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the query request. By default, the system queries call records within the current month. If the call record associated with this ID is not from the current month, you must also specify the `startTime` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询请求唯一id对应的记录信息，默认查询当前月，如requestUniqueId不属于当前月，查询时请传递查询参数 查询开始时间(startTime)
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The call status. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明： 20 webcall, TTS合成失败； 21 webcall, 客户未接 ； 22:webcall, 客户接听； 23: webcall； 已呼叫； 24: webcall, 双方接听；
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province associated with the customer number. Leave this parameter empty to query all provinces. Example: `Beijing`. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city associated with the customer number. Leave this parameter empty to query all cities. Example: `Beijing`. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the time reference for the `startTime` and `endTime` parameters. This parameter applies only when both `startTime` and `endTime` are specified. Valid values:

The default value is
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The start of the query time range, in UNIX timestamp format (in seconds). The `startTime` and `endTime` must be within the same calendar month. The default value is the first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range, in UNIX timestamp format (in seconds). The `startTime` and `endTime` must be within the same calendar month. The default value is the last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The starting offset for the query results. The value must be greater than or equal to `0`. The default value is `0`
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of call records to return. The value must be greater than `0` and no more than `1000`. The default value is `10`
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of a user-defined parameter for filtering. This parameter must be used with `UserFieldValue` to query for an exact match. Fuzzy matching is not supported. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The value of a user-defined parameter for filtering. This parameter must be used with `UserFieldkey` to query for an exact match. Fuzzy matching is not supported. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: The customer number
parameters.help_zh: 客户号码
parameters.name: customer_number

parameters.help_en: The agent ID
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The ID of the outbound call group. An ID must be 2 to 20 characters in length. You can specify one or more group IDs, separated by commas. A maximum of 10 group IDs can be specified. Fuzzy matching is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属外呼组 单个外呼组号2-20位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持10个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The agent number
parameters.help_zh: 座席号码
parameters.name: callee_number

parameters.help_en: The actual display number. In an AXB scenario, this is the virtual number used for the outbound call
parameters.help_zh: 真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，真实外显号码为虚拟号
parameters.name: display_number

parameters.help_en: The actual display number of the callee
parameters.help_zh: 第二侧真实外显号码
parameters.name: callee_display_number

parameters.help_en: The display number (Calling Line Identification)
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: The display number (Calling Line Identification) of the callee
parameters.help_zh: 第二侧外显号码
parameters.name: callee_clid

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the total count of matching call records. Valid values: `0` (No) and `1` (Yes). The default value is `1`
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回总条数；取值说明：0: 不返回，1：返回，不传默认为1
parameters.name: return_count

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the call was answered by a human. Valid values: `1` (Yes) and `0` (No)
parameters.help_zh: 真人接听；取值说明：1-是、0-否
parameters.name: is_real_answer
